title: BUG: Double bolus given
symptom: After administering a bolus through the bolus calculator, an SMB was delivered 5 minutes later with the exact same dosage, effectively delivering the bolus twice within 5 minutes. Additionally, clicking on 'Preferences' causes the screen to turn black and the app to crash.
fix: Update to the latest version, as the issue is probably fixed in the latest version.
evidence_quote: this is unsupported version. update to latest. it's probably fixed
